action.objective: Verify Rg5, keeping rook active on the fifth rank, defending the g4/h4 pawns and cutting off Black's king.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search made g7g5 top exact (894), PV Rg5 Re3 a4, and it is the reserved verification candidate. Its upper-ranked competitor g7g6 is only an upper bound. I verify g7g5 at depth 4 with a full root window and mate probes before comparing or committing.
